g.text: # Conditional Access gap analysis
Evaluated as of 2026-10-01.
Read: conditional-access-policies.json, group-members/, groups.json, named-locations.json,
role-assignments.json, role-definitions.json, role-eligibility-schedule-instances.json, users.json.
| Severity | Findings |
| CRITICAL | 1 |
| HIGH | 4 |
| MEDIUM | 0 |
| LOW | 0 |
| INFO | 0 |
## Findings
| # | Severity | Check | Subject | Finding | Evidence |
| 1 | CRITICAL | CA-GAP-MFA-ADMINS | admins | Admins not covered by an enabled policy that requires
MFA for all cloud apps | 1 of 2 not covered: admin.two@example.com; qualifying policies: Require
MFA for all users, Require MFA for all users (copy) |
| 2 | HIGH | CA-BREAKGLASS-NOT-EXCLUDED | breakglass2@example.com | Break-glass account is covered
by enabled policies | applies: Require MFA for all users, Require MFA for all users (copy) |
| 3 | HIGH | CA-EXCLUSION-HAS-ADMIN | CA Exclusion - Service Accounts (group) | Excluded group
contains admins | admins in the group: admin.two@example.com; excluded from: Require MFA for all
users, Require MFA for all users (copy) |
| 4 | HIGH | CA-GAP-LEGACY-AUTH | all users | Users not covered by an enabled policy that blocks
legacy authentication | 6 of 6 not covered: admin.one@example.com, admin.two@example.com,
partner_example.org#EXT#@example.com, staff.one@example.com, staff.two@example.com,
svc.scanner@example.com; qualifying policies: no qualifying enabled policy |
| 5 | HIGH | CA-GAP-MFA-ALL | all users | Users not covered by an enabled policy that requires MFA
for all cloud apps | 2 of 6 not covered: admin.two@example.com, svc.scanner@example.com; qualifying
policies: Require MFA for all users, Require MFA for all users (copy) |

g.text: | Policy | State | Controls | all users | admins | guests | break-glass |
| Require MFA for all users | enabled | mfa | 4/6 | 1/2 | 1/1 | 1/2 |
| Block legacy authentication | report-only | block | 6/6 | 2/2 | 1/1 | 0/2 |
| Pilot - require compliant device | enabled | compliantdevice | 0/6 | 0/2 | 0/1 | 0/2 |
| Admins - require compliant device | enabled | compliantdevice | 1/6 | 1/2 | 0/1 | 0/2 |
| Require MFA for all users (copy) | enabled | mfa | 4/6 | 1/2 | 1/1 | 1/2 |
Coverage is resolved from exported data and does not simulate sign-ins (no client, platform,
location or risk conditions per user). Verify in the What If tool before changing a policy; the
script changed nothing.
